### Giving for His Glory
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-september-21-2023.html
Passage: Genesis 41:53-57
Points:
- Faced with an unprecedented worldwide famine, Joseph did not hoard grain for himself or the elite.
- He used his position of power and abundance to open the storehouses and feed all who were in need.
- Joseph remained humble and maintained his integrity before God despite holding immense earthly authority.
- Believers blessed by God with prosperity and influence are called to steward those resources generously for His glory.
- Spiritual maturity requires matching authority with accountability, popularity with humility, and prosperity with integrity.
